topic: how Disney theme parks and cruises earn most of the whole company profit
storyAngle: Disney is a film and TV company in your head and a parks company on its books.
doNotClaim: Segment operating income is not net income.
Do not say streaming or TV loses money; no source here says so.

facts.claim: Disney fiscal 2024 Experiences segment (parks, resorts, cruises and consumer products) operating income was $9,272 million.
facts.note: two independent summaries agree; confirm in 10-K

facts.claim: Disney fiscal 2024 total segment operating income was $15,601 million.

derived.claim: Experiences was about 59% of total segment operating income (9,272 / 15,601): nearly six dollars in ten.
